name: x-warm-outreach-gtm
description: Run a 14-day warm outreach ladder on X/Twitter — research 20-50 ICP leads, warm them with thoughtful likes, replies, and quote-tweets over 10+ days until your name is familiar in their notifications, then send a short 3-line DM with one low-friction question and a single casual follow-up. Manual and human-approved only; automated engagement violates X's rules. Use for "X outreach", "Twitter DMs", "warm outreach on X", "book calls from X", or "my cold DMs get ignored".
